title: 4D Triangle Splatting Reconstruction of Dynamic Endoscopic Scenes from Monocular Videos
summary: Robust 4D reconstruction of deformable endoscopic scenes from monocular videos remains challenging due to non-rigid tissue deformation, illumination changes, occlusions, and unknown camera trajectories. Reliable dynamic reconstruction of endoscopies could significantly enhance visualization, diagnostic accuracy and intraoperative guidance of minimally invasive procedures. We propose SurgicalTS, a self-supervised triangle-splatting framework for dynamic endoscopic scene reconstruction from static monocular cameras. The scene is represented by a canonical set of triangles jointly optimized with a deformation network. We introduce a quaternion-based deformation model, an improved color parametrization, spatio-temporal priors, and a redefined initialization strategy that improves completeness under occlusions. Extensive evaluation on challenging in-vivo endoscopy videos from diverse procedures shows that SurgicalTS successfully models soft-tissue deformations and tool-tissue interactions over time, while consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our method also reduces training times while maintaining competitive geometric and photometric accuracy results, highlighting the effectiveness of quaternion-based deformation modelling with physical consistency for robust and efficient 4D reconstruction of endoscopic scenes.
tldr: SurgicalTS proposes a self-supervised triangle-splatting framework for 4D reconstruction of deformable endoscopic scenes from monocular videos, using quaternion-based deformation modeling, improved color parametrization, spatial-temporal priors, and better initialization to handle tissue deformation, occlusions, and tool-tissue interactions, while outperforming prior methods with reduced training time.
tldr_zh: SurgicalTS 提出一种自监督三角面片泼溅框架，用于从单目视频中重建可变形内窥镜场景的 4D 表示，通过基于四元数的形变建模、改进的颜色参数化、时空先验和重定义的初始化策略，处理组织形变、遮挡及器械-组织交互，并在降低训练时间的同时优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 摘要：从单目视频中对可变形内窥镜场景进行鲁棒的4D重建仍具有挑战性，原因在于非刚性组织变形、光照变化、遮挡以及未知的相机轨迹。可靠的动态重建内窥镜图像能够显著增强微创手术的可视化效果、诊断准确性和术中引导。我们提出了SurgicalTS，一种自监督的三角样条溅射框架，用于从静态单目相机进行动态内窥镜场景重建。场景由一组规范三角形表示，并与变形网络联合优化。我们引入了一种基于四元数的变形模型、改进的颜色参数化、时空先验以及重新定义的初始化策略，从而提高了遮挡情况下的完整性。在来自不同手术过程的具有挑战性的体内内窥镜视频上进行的大量评估表明，SurgicalTS能够成功地对软组织变形和器械-组织随时间的相互作用进行建模，并且始终优于最先进的方法。我们的方法还减少了训练时间，同时保持了具有竞争力的几何和光度精度结果，凸显了基于四元数的变形模型在物理一致性方面对实现高效鲁棒的内窥镜场景4D重建的有效性。

title: SurgStream: A Workflow-Anchored Proactive Streaming Framework and Benchmark for Real-Time Surgical Video Understanding
summary: Surgical video understanding is essential for intraoperative assistance such as workflow monitoring, instrument preparation and procedural documentation. Delivering such assistance in real time requires a model to jointly perceive the ongoing scene, remember past surgical events, and respond before clinically relevant moments pass. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly retaining procedural evidence and deciding when to respond in streaming surgical video. In this work, we propose SurgStream, a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding. We first introduce Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM) to record structured instrument-action-target observations and fold them into phase-level summaries, providing compact and queryable surgical memory. Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL) is then devised to supervise response states within clinical windows, enabling timely responses before procedural deadlines. We further introduce SurgStream-Bench, comprising 11.7K streaming interactions across various tasks covering real-time perception, backward memory queries, forward proactive QA, proactive alerts and caption memory. Experiments on SurgStream-Bench show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA. The source code will be available.
tldr: SurgStream proposes a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding, with Workflow-Anchored Memory for structured surgical event memory, Deadline-aware Transition Learning for timely responses, and a 11.7K-interaction benchmark (SurgStream-Bench) covering perception, memory, proactive QA, alerts, and captioning. Experiments show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA.
tldr_zh: SurgStream 提出一种面向实时手术视频理解的工作流锚定主动流式框架，包含工作流锚定记忆（WAM）用于结构化手术事件记忆、截止时间感知转换学习（DTL）用于及时响应，并构建了包含 11.7K 流式交互的基准 SurgStream-Bench，覆盖实时感知、回溯记忆、前瞻主动问答、主动告警和字幕记忆。实验表明在记忆与前瞻主动问答任务上优于现有方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：
手术视频理解对于术中辅助至关重要，例如工作流监测、器械准备和手术过程记录。要在实时中提供此类辅助，模型需要联合感知当前场景、记忆既往手术事件，并在临床相关时刻过去之前作出响应。现有方法在流式手术视频中联合保留过程证据并决定何时响应方面的支持有限。在这项工作中，我们提出 SurgStream，一种面向实时手术视频理解的工作流锚定主动流式框架。我们首先引入工作流锚定记忆（WAM），用于记录结构化的器械-动作-目标观察，并将其归纳为阶段级摘要，从而提供紧凑且可查询的手术记忆。随后设计截止期感知过渡学习（DTL），在临床窗口内监督响应状态，从而能够在过程截止期前及时响应。我们进一步提出 SurgStream-Bench，包含覆盖实时感知、回溯记忆查询、前向主动问答、主动警报和描述记忆等不同任务的 11.7K 条流式交互。在 SurgStream-Bench 上的实验表明，该方法优于最先进方法，尤其是在记忆和前向主动问答方面。源代码将公开。

title: ERIA: An Instruction-Optimized Agent for Clinical EEG Reporting
summary: Clinical EEG interpretation requires integrating technical quality, background and behavioral states, interictal and ictal abnormalities, and overall clinical context across long recordings. We introduce ERIA (EEG Reporting and Instruction-Optimized Agent), a locally deployable framework in which a single 27B language-model controller analyzes whole-recording EEGs by orchestrating specialized parametric and signal-processing tools. ERIA combines learned tools for background abnormality, sleep-wake state, seizure-like activity, and interictal epileptiform discharges with deterministic spectral, amplitude, symmetry, montage, and signal-quality analyses. Rather than fine-tuning the controller or using multi-agent orchestration, ERIA keeps the controller weights, specialist tools, and safety constraints fixed and optimizes only its natural-language analysis policy with GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), using feedback from expert-written EEG reports. GEPA improves physician-aligned whole-recording report quality over the raw policy, and the optimized policy transfers to external EEG benchmarks. On CerebraGloss-Bench and BrainBench Foundational Analysis, ERIA remains competitive with the models evaluated in the original benchmarks. These results show that specialist tools and language-level policy optimization can extend the clinical and general EEG capabilities of a single locally executable model while preserving local inference and traceable tool use.
tldr: ERIA is a locally deployable EEG-reporting agent with a 27B language-model controller that orchestrates specialized signal-processing and learned tools; its natural-language analysis policy is optimized via GEPA against expert reports, improving whole-recording report quality and generalizing to external benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ERIA 是一个可本地部署的脑电报告代理，使用 27B 语言模型控制器协调专用信号处理与学习工具，并通过 GEPA 根据专家报告优化自然语言分析策略，从而提升全记录报告质量并泛化到外部基准。
summary_zh:
摘要：
临床脑电图解读需要整合技术质量、背景与行为状态、发作间期与发作期异常，以及长程记录中的整体临床背景。我们提出 ERIA（EEG Reporting and Instruction-Optimized Agent，脑电图报告与指令优化智能体），这是一个可本地部署的框架，其中单个 27B 语言模型控制器通过协调专门的参数化与信号处理工具来分析全记录脑电图。ERIA 将用于背景异常、睡眠-觉醒状态、类癫痫发作活动和发作间期癫痫样放电的学习型工具，与确定性的频谱、振幅、对称性、导联组合和信号质量分析相结合。ERIA 不微调控制器，也不使用多智能体编排，而是保持控制器权重、专科工具和安全约束固定，仅利用 GEPA（Genetic-Pareto，遗传-帕累托）优化其自然语言分析策略，并使用专家撰写的脑电图报告反馈。GEPA 相比原始策略提高了与医师一致的全记录报告质量，且优化后的策略可迁移至外部脑电图基准。在 CerebraGloss-Bench 和 BrainBench Foundational Analysis 上，ERIA 与原始基准中评估的模型相比仍具竞争力。这些结果表明，专科工具和语言层面的策略优化可以扩展单个本地可执行模型的临床和通用脑电图能力，同时保持本地推理和可追踪的工具使用。

title: CUFormer: Modality-Aware CT-Ultrasound Point Cloud Registration for Orthopedic Navigation
summary: Registering intraoperative Ultrasound (US) bone-surface point clouds to preoperative Computed Tomography (CT) models can support radiation-free orthopedic navigation. Differences in imaging physics produce distinct surface sampling patterns, complicating cross-modal feature matching. Bone strongly reflects ultrasound and casts an acoustic shadow, so US captures only the probe-facing bone surface and leaves most CT points unmatched. This partial coverage makes correspondences ambiguous on near-symmetric bones. We propose CUFormer, a modality-aware registration framework. We introduce a Modality-Aware Transformer (MAT) that encodes input modality through identity embeddings and updates features through modality-specific adapters within a shared geometric matcher. We model imaging visibility and use predicted reference-side visibility to weight coarse and fine correspondences. CUFormer achieves the lowest mean registration errors among evaluated methods on two CT-US datasets, UltraBones100k and UltraBonesHip, and the CT-RGB-D dataset SpineDepth. On UltraBones100k, it reaches mean rotation error 4.53$^\circ$, translation error 3.19\,mm, and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) 2.54\,mm, reducing RMSE by 65.8\% relative to the best-performing baseline by this metric. These results demonstrate CUFormer's effectiveness in aligning partial bone surfaces with preoperative CT across anatomical sites.
tldr: CUFormer is a modality-aware deep registration framework for aligning intraoperative ultrasound bone-surface point clouds to preoperative CT models, using identity embeddings and modality-specific adapters plus visibility weighting to handle partial surface overlap. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on CT-US and CT-RGB-D datasets, substantially reducing RMSE versus baselines.
tldr_zh: CUFormer是一种模态感知的深度配准框架，用于将术中超声骨表面点云与术前CT模型对齐，通过身份嵌入、模态专用适配器和可见性加权处理部分表面重叠问题。在CT-US和CT-RGB-D数据集上达到最先进精度，RMSE较基线大幅降低。
summary_zh:
###  摘要

将术中超声(US)骨表面点云与术前计算机断层扫描(CT)模型进行配准，可支持无辐射的骨科导航。成像物理特性的差异导致不同的表面采样模式，使跨模态特征匹配复杂化。骨组织对超声具有强反射并产生声影，因此US仅能捕捉到面向探头一侧的骨表面，导致大部分CT点无法匹配。这种不完整的覆盖使得在近似对称的骨头上对应关系变得模糊。我们提出了CUFormer，一种模态感知的配准框架。我们引入了一种模态感知Transformer(MAT)，通过身份嵌入对输入模态进行编码，并在共享几何匹配器内通过模态特定适配器更新特征。我们模拟成像可见性，并使用预测的参考侧可见性来加权粗匹配和细匹配对应关系。在两个CT-US数据集（UltraBones100k和UltraBonesHip）以及CT-RGB-D数据集SpineDepth上，CUFormer在评估方法中实现了最低的平均配准误差。在UltraBones100k上，其平均旋转误差达到4.53°，平移误差3.19毫米，均方根误差(RMSE)为2.54毫米，相比该指标下表现最佳的基线方法，RMSE降低了65.8%。这些结果证明了CUFormer在跨解剖部位将部分骨表面与术前CT对齐方面的有效性。

title: State-Aware Virtual Patient Simulation for Training Psychiatrists in Challenging Clinical Scenarios
summary: Psychiatrists must be prepared to manage patients exhibiting challenging psychological states, including suicidal ideation, hallucinations, and other high-risk behaviors. However, opportunities to safely practice such interactions are limited. While recent conversational agents can simulate patients, existing approaches largely rely on large language models (LLMs) to determine patient responses, making it difficult to consistently maintain psychological state, adapt to the clinician's responses, and generate clinically plausible challenges that meaningfully test the clinician. We present a state-aware virtual patient simulation pipeline for training psychiatrists in challenging clinical scenarios. The proposed system maintains an evolving patient state throughout the interaction and orchestrates patient behavior rather than leaving response generation entirely to an LLM. At each interaction, a learning-based behavioral strategy selector determines the type and level of challenge appropriate to the current patient and clinician context. The selected strategy, patient state, clinician response, interaction history, and relevant clinical knowledge are then provided as grounded context to an LLM to generate a semantically relevant and psychologically consistent patient response. Following each session, the system analyzes the interaction and provides feedback to the clinician on their communication and management of the virtual patient.
tldr: This paper proposes a state-aware virtual patient simulation pipeline for psychiatry training that explicitly maintains evolving patient states and uses a learning-based strategy selector to control challenge levels, with LLM-based response generation grounded in context and post-session feedback.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种状态感知的虚拟患者模拟训练系统，用于精神科医生培训；系统显式维护患者状态，通过学习式策略选择器控制挑战强度，并基于上下文由LLM生成患者的心理一致回复，且训练后提供反馈。
summary_zh: 精神科医生必须做好准备，处理表现出挑战性心理状态的患者，包括自杀意念、幻觉及其他高风险行为。然而，安全练习此类互动的机会十分有限。尽管近期的对话智能体能够模拟患者，但现有方法主要依赖大型语言模型（LLM）来决定患者的反应，难以持续维持心理状态、适应临床医生的回应，并产生具有临床可信度的挑战来有效考验临床医生。我们提出了一种状态感知的虚拟患者模拟流水线，用于在具有挑战性的临床场景中培训精神科医生。该系统在互动过程中维护不断演变的患者状态，并编排患者行为，而非将反应生成完全交由LLM处理。在每次互动中，基于学习的行为策略选择器会根据当前患者和临床医生的情境，确定合适的挑战类型和水平。随后，所选策略、患者状态、临床医生回应、互动历史及相关临床知识将作为有据可依的情境提供给LLM，以生成语义相关且心理一致的患者反应。每次会话结束后，系统会分析互动过程，并向临床医生提供关于其与虚拟患者沟通和管理方面的反馈。

title: Accuracy Is Not Risk: Why Medical AI Should Not Report Only Its Most Likely Label
summary: Background. Many medical AI models are trained to reproduce a single reference label and hand the most likely label to the next step in a clinical workflow. A classifier can select that label correctly while providing an inadequate summary for estimating downstream risk. Methods. We use Jeffrey's rule of conditioning to specify when probabilities over intermediate states, such as diagnoses or imaging categories, can be carried forward to an outcome risk. We separate two errors of reporting only the most likely label, discarding the probability of the other states and applying the risk of patients who have the leading diagnosis to a patient who only probably has it. We also give conditions under which the label and the full distribution lead to the same decision, and we propose guardrails for device developers, regulatory reviewers, and health insurers. Results. In a hypothetical chest-pain differential, reporting only the benign leading diagnosis greatly understates the patient's risk of death or cardiac arrest, so a patient who warrants evaluation could be discharged or denied imaging. In a hypothetical BI-RADS example, the most likely category is "probably benign," yet the propagated malignancy risk exceeds the ceiling that defines that category. Conclusions. A predicted label is not an observed state, and a calibrated classifier is not automatically a valid outcome model. Clinical and insurance coverage decisions should rest on the patient's outcome risk, judged against a threshold justified by the consequences of acting and not acting. Developers should state what each model output means and check that every step between the model and the decision preserves the patient's risk.
tldr: This paper argues that medical AI systems should not report only the most likely label, because a correct label can still misrepresent the patient's downstream outcome risk. It uses Jeffrey's rule to formalize when probability distributions over intermediate states should be propagated to risk, and proposes guardrails for developers, regulators, and insurers.
tldr_zh: 本文指出医疗AI仅报告最可能的标签可能会严重低估患者的后续风险，并利用Jeffrey规则形式化何时应传播中间状态的概率分布以得到结果风险，同时为设备开发者、监管者和保险公司提出防护措施。
summary_zh:
摘要

背景：许多医学人工智能模型被训练用于重现单一参考标签，并将最可能的标签交给临床工作流的下一步。分类器可以正确选择该标签，但同时却可能无法为下游风险评估提供充分的摘要。方法：我们使用杰弗里条件化规则来明确在何种情况下，中间状态（如诊断或影像类别）的概率可以延续至结局风险。我们区分了仅报告最可能标签时产生的两种误差：丢弃其他状态的概率，以及将具有主要诊断患者的风险应用于仅可能患有该诊断的患者。我们还给出了标签与完整分布导致相同决策的条件，并为设备开发者、监管审评人员和健康保险公司提出了保障措施。结果：在一个假设的胸痛鉴别诊断中，仅报告良性的主要诊断会大大低估患者死亡或心脏骤停的风险，因此本应接受评估的患者可能被出院或拒绝影像检查。在一个假设的BI-RADS示例中，最可能的类别是“可能良性”，然而传导的恶性肿瘤风险超过了定义该类别的上限。结论：预测标签并非观察到的状态，校准后的分类器并不自动成为有效的结局模型。临床决策和保险覆盖决策应基于患者的结局风险，并以根据采取或不采取措施的后果所确定的阈值进行判断。开发者应说明每个模型输出的含义，并检查从模型到决策之间的每一步是否保持了患者的风险。

title: Prior-Guided Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Fast 4D MRI Reconstruction
summary: Background and purpose: We propose PGPI4MR (prior-guided, physics-informed 4D MRI reconstruction), a deep learning method that leverages information from other respiratory phases or a setup scan, the first 30 s of the same scan, to improve 4D MRI reconstruction without extra scan time. Materials and methods: PGPI4MR is an unrolled network that reconstructs 16 respiratory phases from 60, 30, or 15 s of data, and single 3D volumes, each from 0.29-0.49 s of data, using a setup-scan image. The networks were trained once, on other volunteers, and were not retrained for new volunteers. We evaluated PGPI4MR on measured k-space from three datasets: free-breathing MR-linac (1.5T) and abdominal (3T) scans, and thigh scans with cuff compression (1.5T). All methods, including comparative models, received identical samples and were scored similarly. Results: In vivo, PGPI4MR had the lowest held-out error for 4D MRI at every scan time, and its 16 phases were ready a median of 7.5-13 s after the scan on the 2 GPUs tested. Coupling the 16 respiratory phases reduced the error at 60 s by 9.1% compared with reconstructing each phase alone. For sub-second MRI, the error at 0.49 s was 15.5% lower than that of the best comparison method, classical reconstruction toward the same prior, and on the faster GPU, every 0.29 s window was acquired and reconstructed within 0.5 s. Without retraining, PGPI4MR matched the best methods on the 3T abdominal scans but not on the thigh scans; after retraining on thigh data, it reduced the held-out error by 6.6% relative to the best comparison method. Conclusion: Prior information allowed PGPI4MR to reconstruct 4D and sub-second MRI more accurately than compressed sensing and a published 4D network, within seconds and without extra scan time. This could support 4D MRI for treatment planning and 3D motion monitoring during MR-guided radiotherapy.
tldr: PGPI4MR is an unrolled physics-informed deep learning method for 4D MRI reconstruction that uses prior images from other respiratory phases or a setup scan to reconstruct 16 phases or sub-second 3D volumes from 60/30/15 s or 0.29–0.49 s of data, achieving lower errors and fast reconstruction without extra scan time for MR-guided radiotherapy motion monitoring.
tldr_zh: PGPI4MR 是一种展开式物理信息深度学习方法，利用其他呼吸相位或准备扫描的先验信息，在无需额外扫描时间的情况下，从 60/30/15 秒数据重建 16 个呼吸相位，或从 0.29–0.49 秒数据重建单个体积，并在 MR 引导放疗的 4D MRI 与亚秒 MRI 中实现更低误差和快速重建。
summary_zh:
摘要：
背景与目的：我们提出PGPI4MR（先验引导、物理信息驱动的4D MRI重建），这是一种深度学习方法，利用其他呼吸时相或定位扫描（即同一扫描的前30秒）的信息，在不增加扫描时间的情况下改善4D MRI重建。材料与方法：PGPI4MR是一种展开网络，可从60秒、30秒或15秒的数据重建16个呼吸时相，并利用定位扫描图像从0.29–0.49秒的数据重建单个3D体积。这些网络仅在志愿者数据上训练一次，不针对新志愿者重新训练。我们在三组实测k空间数据上评估了PGPI4MR：自由呼吸的MR-linac（1.5T）和腹部（3T）扫描，以及带袖带加压的大腿扫描（1.5T）。所有方法（包括对比模型）均接受相同样本并以相同标准评分。结果：在体实验中，PGPI4MR在所有扫描时长下均获得最低的4D MRI留出误差，其16个时相在测试的2块GPU上于扫描结束后中位7.5–13秒内准备好。将16个呼吸时相联合重建，与单独重建各时相相比，在60秒数据下误差降低了9.1%。对于亚秒级MRI，在0.49秒数据下的误差比最佳对比方法（面向同一先验的经典重建）低15.5%；在较快的GPU上，每个0.29秒窗口均可在0.5秒内完成采集与重建。在不重新训练的情况下，PGPI4MR在3T腹部扫描中与最佳方法相当，但在大腿扫描中未达到同等水平；在大腿数据上重新训练后，其留出误差相较最佳对比方法降低了6.6%。结论：先验信息使PGPI4MR能够在数秒内、无额外扫描时间的情况下，以高于压缩感知和已发表的4D网络的精度重建4D及亚秒级MRI。这可为MR引导放疗中的治疗计划和三维运动监测提供4D MRI支持。

title: Accounting for Irregular State Transitions through Belief Estimation in Online Medical Consultation
summary: While online medical consultation broadens access, unprompted patient disclosures and topic shifts frequently disrupt clinician inquiry, leaving clinical states progressively revealed. We characterize these dynamics using both existing evaluation metrics and task-specific interaction metrics designed in this work. Through an empirical study across 16 medical dialogue datasets, we show that authentic online interactions exhibit substantially lower contextual continuity and higher unpredictability than offline and simulated benchmarks. We propose PRISM (Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine), a framework inspired by partially observable Markov decision processes that decouples latent state estimation from action selection to address drifting dialogue trajectories. Specifically, PRISM factorizes clinical triage into belief estimation, policy optimization, and response realization. By maintaining an evolving posterior belief over consultation states and conditioning action selection on the maximum a posteriori state, PRISM advances clinical goals while accommodating patient-initiated shifts. Extensive evaluations show that PRISM substantially outperforms frontier LLMs and clinical agents, achieving a 22.40 percentage point gain in clinical decision accuracy alongside decisive improvements in response generation, surpassing the strongest baseline by 5.51 points in BERTScore_F1. Furthermore, ablation studies show that providing oracle consultation states consistently boosts response quality across all evaluated baselines by guiding their action reasoning, yielding average gains of 5.58 points in BERTScore_F1.
tldr: The paper introduces PRISM, a POMDP-inspired framework for online medical consultation that decouples latent belief estimation from action selection to handle irregular patient-initiated topic shifts, achieving large gains in clinical decision accuracy and response quality over frontier LLMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出PRISM框架，借鉴部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，将潜在状态估计与动作选择解耦，以应对在线医疗咨询中患者引起的主题漂移，并在临床决策准确率和回复质量上大幅超越前沿大语言模型。
summary_zh:
摘要：
尽管在线医疗咨询拓宽了就医渠道，但患者主动披露的信息和话题转移时常打断临床医生的问询，导致临床状态逐步显现。我们利用现有评估指标以及本工作中设计的任务特定交互指标来刻画这些动态。通过对16个医疗对话数据集的实证研究，我们发现真实的在线交互在上下文连续性上显著低于离线及模拟基准，且不可预测性更高。我们提出PRISM（面向医学的基于推断状态的策略推理）框架，其灵感来自部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，将潜在状态估计与动作选择解耦，以应对漂移的对话轨迹。具体而言，PRISM将临床分诊分解为信念估计、策略优化和响应实现。通过维护对咨询状态的动态后验信念，并基于最大后验状态条件化动作选择，PRISM在适应患者主动话题转移的同时推进临床目标。大量评估表明，PRISM显著优于前沿大语言模型和临床智能体，在临床决策准确率上取得22.40个百分点的提升，同时在响应生成方面也有决定性改进，在BERTScore_F1上超越最强基线5.51分。此外，消融研究表明，提供真实咨询状态可通过引导各评估基线的动作推理持续提升其响应质量，在BERTScore_F1上平均提升5.58分。
